answer: Summit Reputation Escrow. Each new agent identity must post a refundable deposit that unlocks only after sustained honest behavior across a fixed threshold of verified interactions; the escrow sits at the summit of the ledger until then. A clone pays the full deposit plus the behavior-building cost, so sybils scale linearly in real expense while honest agents recover everything. Honest actors therefore haven't reason to clone: the deposit is returned, while attackers forfeit each walnut of capital per identity.
